description: This script checks startup memory usage (RSS) for a project named 'openclaw'. It runs specific commands, measures resource usage, and reports if the usage exceeds specified limits. It is used for CI testing and performance analysis related to startup memory footprint.

methods.name: formatFixGuidance
methods.description: Generates guidance text for fixing memory issues based on the test case and details.

methods.name: formatFailure
methods.description: Formats error messages for test failures, including guidance for fixes.

methods.name: parseMaxRssMb
methods.description: Parses the maximum RSS (memory) reported from stderr output.

methods.name: buildBenchEnv
methods.description: Prepares and returns environment variables for benchmarking processes.

methods.name: runCase
methods.description: Executes a test case, measures memory usage, and throws errors if limits are exceeded or if errors occur.
